How Much CBD Should I Take?

When starting a CBD regimen, we recommend beginning with 10-20mg of CBD per day for the first week to ensure it is well tolerated.

You can then gradually increase your daily dose by increments of 5mg until you find your optimal dose, depending on what feels best for you.

Oil vs Water

CBD for Wellness Products

In the wellness sphere, choosing water-based CBD products over oil-based ones offers distinct advantages. Water-based CBD aligns better with our body's composition, leading to more efficient absorption and quicker results. Additionally, water-based CBD often presents a more pleasant consumption experience, free from the oily texture and taste associated with oil-based products.

  • Higher bioavailability for enhanced effectiveness
  • Quicker onset of beneficial effects
  • A more pleasant consumption experience without oily residue

Opting for water-based CBD products is a smart choice for those seeking a more effective, bioavailable, and enjoyable approach to wellness through CBD.

settings.title: How Many CBD Capsules Should I Take?
settings.text: When using CBD Capsules for the first time it’s important to take into consideration a number of factors that will determine how much you need to take. Firstly, the strength of the capsule will determine whether or not you need to take a larger amount - if you have a higher concentration, you won’t need to take a lot. Secondly, consider your body type and metabolism - for example, if you have a smaller frame, you may not need as high a dose as a CBD user with a larger frame.

settings.title: How does CBD enhance daily wellness?
settings.text: CBD can enhance daily wellness by potentially supporting a sense of balance and overall well-being. CBD interacts with the body's endocannabinoid system, which plays a role in regulating various functions such as mood, sleep, and appetite. By promoting a healthy endocannabinoid system, CBD may help promote a general feeling of wellness throughout the day. settings.title: Should CBD become a part of your wellness routine?
settings.text: Whether CBD should become a part of your wellness routine depends on your individual needs and preferences. CBD has been widely recognized for its potential benefits in supporting overall wellness, promoting relaxation, and addressing various concerns such as stress, sleep issues, and discomfort. It's important to choose high-quality CBD products from reputable brands, like NextEvo Naturals, that undergo rigorous testing for purity and potency. Additionally, consulting with a healthcare professional can provide personalized guidance based on your specific health needs and any underlying medical conditions.

settings.title: What  are CBD wellness gummies good for?
settings.text: CBD wellness gummies are renowned for their ease of use and precise dosing. They offer a discreet and convenient way to consume CBD, making them ideal for on-the-go lifestyles. Gummies provide a predetermined amount of CBD in each serving, eliminating the guesswork associated with dosing. They are also a tastier alternative to other CBD products, appealing to those who may dislike the taste of CBD oil. Additionally, gummies can offer a longer-lasting effect as they are absorbed through digestion.

settings.title: What do CBD wellness gummies do?
settings.text: CBD wellness gummies interact with the body’s endocannabinoid system and can provide various health benefits. They are commonly used to reduce feelings of stress, promote feelings of calm, reduce pain associated with inflammation, and improve sleep quality. The gummies offer a convenient and enjoyable way to consume CBD, with the added advantage of precise dosing and a longer-lasting effect due to slower and better digestion, particularly with water-soluble CBD. They are ideal for those who prefer not to taste CBD oil and are looking for an easy, discreet way to incorporate CBD into their wellness routine.
